data: Game theory studies interactive decision-making and our objective is to understand the impact of interactions of multiple players and the resulting dynamics in a market environment. The introductory course in game theory will familiarize students with strategic behaviour and its applications in business decision making and several fields such as industrial organization, corporate finance, environmental economics, trade and political science. The course will cover several solution concepts starting with Nash Equilibrium, which will be modified under imperfect and incomplete/complete information scenarios. The concepts will be applied to case studies in bargaining, negotiation, pricing and market entry decisions.
